specials.name: Nitro Reel
specials.behavior:
A Nitro Reel always covers two symbol positions and contains 4, 6, 8, 10
or 12 identical 1x1 payout symbols. A big Nitro Reel always covers six
symbol positions and contains 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 identical 2x2 payout
symbols.
The Nitro upgrade feature upgrades the number of symbols in the Nitro
Reels.

base_game_loop.summary: Gritty Kitty: paid spin on 4x6 (expands to 8 rows). Up to 262144 ways to win. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Assassin Spins. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x6 (expands to 8 rows). Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: Up to 262144 ways to win

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

Game rules
 Gritty Kitty is a 6 reels and 4 rows slot with spinning reels and dropping
 symbols, expanding reels up to 8 rows, a charged feature Feature Reel
 and up to 262144 ways to win.
 The minimum bet is € 0.20, the maximum bet is € 100.00.
 Each bet is 100 coins.
 Wins begin with the first leftmost reel and only pay from left to right on
 consecutive reels. No gaps between the reels are allowed. Only the
 longest payline per active payline is paid out. Coin symbols pays out
 together with other symbol wins.
 A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the
 Spin button.
 The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold
 down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of
 game rounds to be played automatically.
